tools.name: get_friendly_guid
tools.description: Get a FriendlyGUID. Optionally provide a memorable seed word or phrase; FriendlyGUID converts it to a valid GUID/UUID and can update the page.

seed.description: Optional memorable word or phrase to convert into a friendly GUID. When omitted, the current page GUID is completed or a new friendly GUID is generated.

uppercase.description: Return the GUID in uppercase. Defaults to the page casing setting.

updatePage.description: Update the visible FriendlyGUID input with the generated GUID.
